title: Polynomial projective-line projection is an isomorphism on each standard chart
statement: Let k be a field and S=k[x₀,x₁] with its total-degree grading. Let hcov assert that the basic opens D₊(xᵢ), indexed by ULift(Fin 2), cover Proj S. The canonical linear projection [def-pc-linear-pair-morphism] defined by xᵢ restricts to an isomorphism over each standard open of the base-change projective line [def-sc-p1-standard].

source.place: Lemma 27.13.3 and its base change to Spec k; explicit chart computation in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.LinearProjection.isFinite_linearProjection_restrict

proof.text: The preimage of the i-th standard open under linearProjection is D₊(xᵢ), by linearProjection_preimage_standardOpen. The affine chart Spec S_(xᵢ) maps isomorphically to this preimage through the canonical awayι open immersion. Introduce the corresponding isoOfRangeEq e. The identity linearChartSection_self says that the auxiliary basic open for xᵢ/xᵢ is all of this affine chart.

Compose the restricted projection with e on the source and standardOpenIso on the target. The formulas awayι_linearProjection and homOfSections_resLE_standardOpenIso_hom identify this composite with AffineSpace.homOfVector over the coefficient algebra map, with coordinates xⱼ/xᵢ. This is the same coordinate calculation used in the already proved isFinite_linearProjection_restrict, specialized to the polynomial grading.

The algebra equivalence homogeneousLocalizationAwayXEquiv [lem-weil-pbc-dehomogenization-polynomial-ring] identifies S_(xᵢ) with the polynomial ring in variables j ≠ i. Reindex the complementary variables by the bijection induced by ULift.down. Its inverse sends Xⱼ to xⱼ/xᵢ. The affine hom_ext lemma, SpecIso_inv_over, SpecIso_inv_appTop_coord and naturality of ΓSpecIso therefore identify the coordinate morphism with Spec of this ring equivalence followed by the inverse affine SpecIso. Both are isomorphisms; cancel the source and target chart isomorphisms to obtain IsIso of the restricted projection.

theorem isIso_polynomial_linearProjection_restrict (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (hcov : (⨆ i : ULift.{v} (Fin 2),
      basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (X i.down)) = ⊤)
    (i : ULift.{v} (Fin 2)) :
    IsIso (linearProjection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
      (fun j : ULift.{v} (Fin 2) ↦ X j.down)
      (fun j ↦ X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k j.down) hcov ∣_
        ProjectiveSpace.standardOpen (ULift.{v} (Fin 2)) (Spec (.of k)) i)
